Note:
[General game notes]
Cruncheevos script: https://github.com/akleemans/retroachievements-scripts
The game has a randomization table with 8 possible level orders at 0x24c5 - 0x2504

[8-bit] Per-scene ID, one value for each minigame, the intro card and the menus (used for "actually in gameplay")
0x00 = Stage intro card and transitions
0x01 = Forest, and briefly at every stage start
0x02 = Snowboard 
0x03 = Swimmer
0x04 = Title / menu
0x05 = Title / menu
0x09 = Seen after Ending
0x0a = Ice cave
0x0b = Ice cave symbol door
0x0c = Endgame part 2
0x0d = Witch endgame
0x0e = Ending

[8-bit] Cheat indicator
0=no cheat
1=infinite lives
2=harmless logs in forest
[8-bit] Gold bags collected in current stage (shown on HUD). On death, some bags are dropped. Minimum required per difficulty (light/normal/heavy) is Forest 17/25/30, Snowboard 5/9/14, Swimmer 5/7/9
[8-bit] Total gold bags banked across completed stages

[8-bit] Hugo jump state (Forest)
0x00 = Jump started
0x01 = Ready (A released)
[16-bit] Pointer to current level randomization entry

[8-bit] Death sequence flag (set on death)
0x00 = Alive
0x01 = Dying
[8-bit] Last completed stage (stage ID, see 0xffed), set on the completion frame

[8-bit] Stage-in-progress marker (0xff = stage being played. On completion: Index of next stage, wrapping among the 4 minigames  (Forest: 1, Snowboard: 2, Swimmer: 3, Ice Cave: 0, Witch endgame: 5, Endgame pt. 2: 6)
[8-bit] Gold bags collected in current life (Snowboard/Swimmer only) - prefer 0xc3eb over this

[8-bit] Hugo vertical state (Ice Cave only)
0x00 = On ground
0x10 = Rising
0x20 = Falling

[8-bit] Stage (will be also 0x00 on Main menu)
0x00 = Forest
0x01 = Snowboard
0x02 = Swimmer
0x03 = Cave
0x04 = Witch's endgame
0x05 = Endgame part 2
0x06 = Ending
